description.narrative: The Overall Objective (impact) of this action is to support delivery of global ocean commitments by 2030 and leaving in place a stronger and more complete and gender-sensitive governance architecture that can support delivery post-2030.The Specific Objectives (Outcomes) of this action are to:1.Enhance capacities to respond to key global ABNJ biodiversity-related processes;2.    Expand access to and capacities to perform and apply research on MGRs and related data and benefit from their use, promoting the participation of women;3.Enhance capacities to develop state of the art proposals for ABMTs including MPAs in ABNJ to be submitted to the future BBNJ COP.The Outputs to be delivered by this action contributing to the corresponding Specific Objectives (outcomes) are: Contributing to Specific Objective 11.1 Capacities to implement key global ABNJ biodiversity-related processes are enhanced at national level.1.2 Capacities to implement key global ABNJ biodiversity-related processes are enhanced at regional and global level.1.3 Regional ocean governance, including in ABNJ, is reinforced by establishing or strengthening formal ocean coordination mechanisms, promoting the participation of women in the decision-making processes1.4 Coordination and awareness of the Programme and other related opportunities is providedContributing to Specific Objective 22.1 Regional centres (and/or networks) of excellence on MGR are scaled up in the Global South.2.2  Institutions are enabled to access and use research opportunities thanks to regional and transregional training and outreachContributing to Specific Objective 33.1 Lessons are captured and utilized from existing, emerging and new initiatives that can enhance conservation and sustainable use in ABNJ.3.2 Initiatives in biologically important ABNJ areas that have the potential to become high seas MPAs are scaled-up and advanced.
